name: Bootstrap Simple Carousel
project_description:
The module provides the carousel block. It uses the bootstrap carousel with all the features of bootstrap script.

All the info and available settings yon can see on the bootstrap page.

You can create a create carousel in easy way, just install module and add items in admin panel. After that place block in any region, that's all.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 The bootstrap carousel module: 

 
 Possibility to use all the bootstrap carousel settings and elements 
 Alt and title attributes for images 
 Interval time in milliseconds 
 Control options (arrows, indicators, pause image cycling on mouse hover) 
 Excellent integration with image styles 
 Provides a carousel block 
 Suitable form for add/edit/delete/order carousel items 
 The module supports v3.x/v4.x/5.x of Bootstrap (default 5.3.3, for module versions bellow 2.1 - 4.6.0) 
 
 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 Bootstrap Carousel has following dependencies:

 Drupal core modules 
 
 Image 
 Block 
 
 Web toolkit 
 
 bootstrap carousel.js 
 
 The module depends on bootstrap framework, so you need to use any bootstrap theme or include the bootstrap framework or just enable the module setting to include needed files (Bootstrap v5.3.3 for module versions 2.1 - 3.x)

 Back to top 

 Installation 
 To install Bootstrap Simple Carousel:

 
 
You need to include the bootstrap framework, you can do it in many ways:
 
 Download the v3.x/v4.x/5.x of Bootstrap 
 Use any bootstrap theme 
 Activate the "assets" setting in the module settings 
 
 
 Enable Bootstrap Simple Carousel and all of the modules that it requires. 
 
 Back to top 

 Which version of module should you use? 
 
 8.x-1.65 - for drupal < 8.9 
 2.0.1 - for drupal 8.9 - 10.x and bootstrap 3.x - 4.x 
 2.1.0 - for drupal 8.9 - 10.x and bootstrap 5.x 
 3.0.0 - for drupal 11 and bootstrap 5.x 
 
 Be aware that bootstrap 5 does not require jQuery, but e. g. bootstrap 4 - requires jquery version bellow 4.0

 Back to top 

 Tips 
 NOTE: if you will be use the image styles for bootstrap items, you need to set up the same width for the "bootstrap carousel" container
